Maya: Heads up 1 1 Riku's birthday next Friday. Quick ops q: office cake or care package for remote folks?
Ethan: Care package pls. cake never ships well. :cake: -> :package:
Sam: Care package + small office treat sounds good. low maintenance.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started: cake 0, care package 2, hybrid 1
Lina: Hybrid w/ a tiny desk cupcake for onsite and a mailer box with tea + cookie for remotes.
Maya: Budget check: we have $120 for this. How many remotes? 4.
Ethan: I can coordinate shipping addresses. I'll compile list by Tue.
Sam: Also can make a 2-min slideshow of pics. @Maya send me 3 fun Riku photos?
Maya: Sent in DM.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder set for shipping label creation at 1910020000.
Lina: Note: label "no peanuts" for one recipient.
Maya: Final: hybrid plan approved. I'll create sign-up for packing/office pick-up. Cheers!
Ethan: I'll handle postage.
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread summary: plan=hybrid, budget=$120, remotes=4, owner=Ethan.
